title: PPMT is not PMT minus IPMT, and sits further from the exact value than PMT
statement: On the 30-year loan PPMT(0.05/12,k,360,200000), for k from 1 to 12 every PPMT answer is 3 to 5 units above the correctly rounded principal payment, while PMT is 1 unit away. Excel's own answers do not satisfy the identity: in binary64, PMT - IPMT equals PPMT in 2 of the 12 periods and PMT - PPMT equals IPMT in 7. So reproducing PPMT from PMT and IPMT misses the last bits.
basis: Twelve recorded periods of one loan, read from the catalogue capture, compared with exact values and with Excel's own PMT and IPMT by binary64 subtraction.
inferred: That PPMT uses its own discount factor rather than PMT's em is inferred: the period-1 answer is not P*(1+em) for either em consistent with PMT, and not a difference of two binary64 values on the grid its bits would need.

correct.how: mpmath at 800 bits with rate the binary64 0x3f71111111111111 that 0.05/12 evaluates to; correctly rounded.

repros.recorded_in: Excel 16.0.20527.20088 Current Channel, Windows 64-bit (NT 10.0.26200), x86-64, AMD Ryzen 7 4800H, en-ZA
